FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and jovial man with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled man named THOMAS (he).

KING
(to Thomas)
I have a vision, Thomas. A vision of a new era for our kingdom. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

THOMAS
(confused)
Futurism, sire?

KING
(nodding)
Yes, yes. We must shed our medieval ways and embrace the sleek, modern aesthetic of... of... (he consults a parchment)...of vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his courtiers, all of whom are dressed in the most outlandish, futuristic attire. They are all wearing neon-colored jumpsuits, sporting hairdos that defy gravity, and sporting the most ostentatious, oversized jewelry.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We must make our kingdom a beacon of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of retro-futurism.

COURTIER 1 (she)
But sire, what about our traditional armor? Our trusty steeds?

KING
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... so... (he searches for the right words)...so last season. We must upgrade to... to... (he consults a parchment)...to hoverbikes.

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The streets are lined with sleek, neon-lit buildings, and the air is filled with the hum of hoverbikes. The king, resplendent in his futuristic attire, rides through the streets on a hoverbike, surrounded by his courtiers.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We must make our kingdom a hub of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of intergalactic commerce.

COURTIER 2 (he)
But sire, what about our traditional trade routes? Our merchants?

KING
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... so... (he searches for the right words)...so quaint. We must establish trade routes with... with... (he consults a parchment)...with the moon colonies.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is sitting at a desk, surrounded by his advisors. He is wearing a pair of oversized, mirrored sunglasses.

KING
(to his advisors)
We must make our kingdom a center of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of interdimensional research.

ADVISOR 1 (she)
But sire, what about our traditional military? Our knights?

KING
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... so... (he searches for the right words)...so medieval. We must establish a... a... (he consults a parchment)...a space army.

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a hub of intergalactic commerce, with merchants from all over the galaxy coming to trade with the king. The king, resplendent in his futuristic attire, rides through the streets on a hoverbike, surrounded by his courtiers.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We have done it, my friends. We have created a kingdom that is truly... truly... (he searches for the right words)...truly vaporwave.

FADE TO BLACK.
